description: Compare two saved benchmark runs head-to-head. Native runs: avg + p95 for FPS/CPU/memory, jank. Browser runs: FPS, frame gaps, long tasks, slow-frame scripts, input, DOM and heap (no CPU). Both: render counts — total, commits, and wasted (parent cascades + identity-only prop churn) — each with deltas. Use comparable workloads and inspect available metrics together. A wasted-render delta alone does not prove a fix.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

reportIdB.description: Second report id to compare against the baseline.

name: compare_reports
